```{python}
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio # to render plotly output in HTML files
pio.renderers.default = "iframe" # to render plotly output in HTML files
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import pandas as pd
import os
import datetime
import great_tables as gt
```

```{python}
data_path = "../csv/ciso_grid_py.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(data_path)
data["period"] = pd.to_datetime(data["period"])

end_date = data["period"].max()
start_date = end_date -  datetime.timedelta(days = 30)

meta_path = "../metadata/ciso_log_py.csv"
meta = pd.read_csv(meta_path)
```

## Row {.tabset}

```{python}
#| title: Hourly Demand By Provider 

fig = px.line(data, x="period", y="value", color="subba")
fig = fig.update_layout(
    xaxis=dict(
        rangeselector=dict(
            buttons=list([
                dict(count=1,
                     label="1m",
                     step="month",
                     stepmode="backward"),
                dict(count=6,
                     label="6m",
                     step="month",
                     stepmode="backward"),
                dict(count=1,
                     label="YTD",
                     step="year",
                     stepmode="todate"),
                dict(count=1,
                     label="1y",
                     step="year",
                     stepmode="backward"),
                dict(step="all")
            ])
        ),
        rangeslider=dict(
            visible=True
        ),
        type="date",
        range=[start_date,end_date]
    )
)

fig.show()
```

gt.GT(meta.tail(20))
